errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the chart shows data 'over time until 2010'. The x-axis represents age, not time. The chart compares different population groups by age.
The x-axis tick labels are in steps of 10 years (20, 30, 40, etc.), not 5 years.
The y-axis tick labels are in steps of 20 percentage points (0, 20, 40, etc.), not 10%.
This phrase is contradictory and nonsensical. The legend entry is 'ohne Migrationshintergrund' (without migration background).
The value for the black line ('ohne Migrationshintergrund') at age 20 is approximately 60%, not 78%.
The value for the black line ('ohne Migrationshintergrund') at age 70 is approximately 5%, not 65%.

errors.text_span: Eine graue gestrichelte Linie stellt den Anteil der erwerbstätigen Personen mit Migrationshintergrund dar, die in Deutschland geboren wurden und bis 2009 zugewandert sind
errors.evidence: This description incorrectly merges two separate data series: the grey line represents 'in Deutschland geboren' and the light blue line represents 'zugewandert bis 2009'. Additionally, the grey line is solid, not 'gestrichelte' (dashed).
The value for the grey line ('in Deutschland geboren') at age 20 is approximately 52%, not 60%.
The value for the grey line ('in Deutschland geboren') at age 70 is approximately 10%, not 45%.
The description completely omits the light blue line, which corresponds to the category 'zugewandert bis 2009'. It incorrectly combines this category with another.
The legend for the blue line states 'zugewandert seit 2010' (immigrated since 2010), not 'bis 2010' (until 2010).
The value for the blue line ('zugewandert seit 2010') at age 20 is approximately 38%, not 30%.
The value for the blue line ('zugewandert seit 2010') at age 70 is close to 0%, not 10%.
